name: Get a message
description: The action that gets message details from the user's mailbox

message_id.description: Full Microsoft Graph item ID of the target message in the mailbox specified by User. Use message_id returned by Search messages or List messages in a folder for this mailbox. Copy the complete value (often starting with AAMk or AAk); do not use email.message_id or an Internet Message-ID such as <...@...>. A message object containing message_id is also accepted.
message_id.title: Graph Message ID

user.description: The user identifier or user principal name (UPN)

error_details.description: Safe structured errors. retryable refers to retrying the whole action; it is false after a modifying request.

message_id.description: The Microsoft Graph message item ID

outcome.description: Overall action outcome. Partial, failed and unknown outcomes also flag an SDK action error; inspect retained results before retrying.

parent_folder_id.description: The Graph parent folder ID at retrieval time.

user.description: The echo of the user identifier used for this action
